name: Turkey & Havarti Toaster-Oven Melt
whyItWorks: Lean deli protein + zero-lactose Havarti on soft refined bread gives you a proper hot sandwich with zero friction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer thin-sliced deli turkey and plain Havarti on potato bread or soft pita. Toast open-faced at 375F for 5 mins until crisp, never microwave-soggy.
